items.informal_name: Finite Sum Representation of Polynomials with Bounded Degree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n : ℕ},
  p.natDegree < n → p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, if the natural degree of $ p $ is less than $ n $, then $ p $ can be expressed as the sum $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (\text{coeff}_p(i)) \cdot X^i $, where $ \text{coeff}_p(i) $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial as Sum of Monomials Over Range with Degree Constraint
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  p.natDegree < n → p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, if the natural degree of $ p $ is strictly less than a natural number $ n $, then $ p $ equals the sum of the monomials $ (\text{coeff}\, p\, i) \cdot X^i $ for all $ i $ in the range $ 0 $ to $ n-1 $. This expresses $ p $ as a finite sum of its coefficient-monomial terms when its degree is bounded by $ n $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial Expansion as Sum of Coefficients Times $ X^i $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, $ p $ is equal to the sum from $ i = 0 $ to $ \text{natDegree}(p) $ of $ (\text{coeff}_p(i)) \cdot X^i $, where $ \text{coeff}_p(i) $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $.

items.informal_name: Polynomial as Sum of Monomials up to Natural Degree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, $ p $ equals the sum over $ i $ from $ 0 $ to $ \deg(p) $ of the monomial $ (\text{coeff}_p(i)) \cdot X^i $, where $ \deg(p) $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $. Formally, $ p = \sum_{i=0}^{\deg(p)} (\text{coeff}_p(i) \cdot X^i) $.

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) = p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, $ p $ is equal to the sum of $ a_n X^n $ for all exponents $ n $ in the support of $ p $, where $ a_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $.
